items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: You're repeating something that somebody showed me in a book that was written by Ross Russell, in which Ross Russell was talking about a jazz date...

ctx.x: Bird reminds me of something--someone asked me, you're going to go up and talk to George, ask him about how he and Bird got into a hassle, that he wouldn't play with Bird or Bird wouldn't play with him, whatever, on a date; I don't know. Do you remember that, am I making that up?

You're repeating something that somebody showed me in a book that was written by Ross Russell, in which Ross Russell was talking about a jazz date that we were doing out on the coast, Bird and Diz and I think Lucky Thompson was on it, Arvin Garrison, myself; it was a bunch of people that Ross Russell had gathered together and on the night of the date two of the guys were busted in California, in town and didn't arrive at the date. There was a big thing about postponing it and changing men and how it came out to…
Is it fair to ask you, who is the favorite jazz player you ever played with? And define it any way you want.
